<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Detention Block Control Room''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：監房ブロックコントロールルーム</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。デス・スターに捕まっているキャラクターは、すべて解放される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-123o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Detention Block Control Room.

'''Light Side:''' If you control here, add 1 to the Force drain. All characters held prisoner on the Death Star are released.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Detention Block Control Room]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
